## Props (3)

| Prop | Type | Required | Declared default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `defaultOpen` | `boolean \| undefined` | no | `false` | Initial open state when uncontrolled. For controlled use, bind `v-model:open`. |
| `modal` | `boolean \| undefined` | no | `true` | Whether the menu traps focus and blocks interaction with the page behind it. Set `false` for menus layered over live page chrome, such as a site nav. |
| `open` | `boolean \| undefined` | no | `undefined` | Whether the menu is open. Left `undefined` (the default) Reka UI owns the open state and the trigger toggles it without a binding. |

## Variants and controlled state

**Controlled and uncontrolled — `open`.** Both forms are supported, and they are
different contracts rather than two spellings of one.

```vue
<!-- Uncontrolled: the component owns the value. -->
<DzDropdownMenu />

<!-- Controlled: you own it, and the component only ever asks. -->
<DzDropdownMenu v-model:open="value" />

<!-- Controlled, long form — the same thing, written out. -->
<DzDropdownMenu :open="value" @update:open="value = $event" />
```

**Where each variant is shown.** 9 stories in
`packages/core/stories/overlays/DzDropdownMenu.stories.ts`: `Default`, `Side Gallery`, `With Disabled Items`, `With Separator Groups`, `Interactive`, `Dark Mode Preview`, `Accessibility: Keyboard Navigation`, `Real World: User Account Menu`, `States`.

## Parts, states and tokens

**Parts** — addressable nodes, emitted as `data-part`. Reach one with the selector, or pass
classes by name through the typed `ui` prop; a typo in `ui` is a type error rather than a class
that lands nowhere.

When your `class` and a `ui` entry set the same Tailwind utility, **your `class` wins**: the
merge order is recipe → `ui` → `class`, and `cn()` is tailwind-merge, so the last one through
takes effect. That is what lets you restyle a wrapper someone else built without `!important`.

| Part | Selector | Always present |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `content` | `[data-part="content"]` | no — renders zero or more than once |
| `item` | `[data-part="item"]` | no — renders zero or more than once |
| `prefix` | `[data-part="prefix"]` | no — renders zero or more than once |
| `separator` | `[data-part="separator"]` | no — renders zero or more than once |
| `suffix` | `[data-part="suffix"]` | no — renders zero or more than once |


### Keyboard interaction

**10 declared bindings.** Rendered from the
component's own keyboard contract, not from the APG pattern it is held to — where the two
differ, the difference is the point.

| Key | Where | Action | WCAG | Pattern |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ArrowDown` | — | Move focus to the next item, wrapping at the end. | `2.1.1` | [`menu`](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/menu/) |
| `ArrowUp` | — | Move focus to the previous item, wrapping at the start. | `2.1.1` | [`menu`](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/menu/) |
| `Home` | — | Move focus to the first item. | `2.1.1` | [`menu`](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/menu/) |
| `End` | — | Move focus to the last item. | `2.1.1` | [`menu`](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/menu/) |
| `Enter` | — | Invoke the focused item and close the menu. | `2.1.1` | [`menu`](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/menu/) |
| `Space` | — | Invoke the focused item and close the menu. | `2.1.1` | [`menu`](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/menu/) |
| `ArrowRight` | `item with a submenu` | Open the focused item submenu and focus its first item. | `2.1.1` | [`menu`](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/menu/) |
| `ArrowLeft` | `submenu open` | Close the current submenu and return to its parent item. | `2.1.1` | [`menu`](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/menu/) |
| `Escape` | — | Close the menu and return focus to the trigger. | `2.1.1`, `2.1.2` | [`menu`](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/menu/) |
| any character key | — | Move focus to the next item whose label starts with that character. | `2.1.1` | [`menu`](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/menu/) |
